items.name: langfuse
items.description: 🪢 Open source agent evals & observability: Trace, evaluate, and improve LLM applications with one open platform.

items.name: iFixAi
items.description: Independent Auditing of AI Agents. Run by human or the agent itself, to answer the most crucial question in the AI Agent Economy. Is the agent doing what is supposed to do? With iFixAi you can have this answer in less than 120 seconds.

items.name: mlflow
items.description: The open source AI engineering platform for agents, LLMs, and ML models. MLflow enables teams of all sizes to debug, evaluate, monitor, and optimize production-quality AI applications while controlling costs and managing access to models and data.

items.name: promptfoo
items.description: Test your prompts, agents, and RAGs. Red teaming/pentesting/vulnerability scanning for AI. Compare performance of GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, and more. Simple declarative configs with command line and CI/CD integration.  Used by OpenAI and Anthropic.

items.name: opik
items.description: Debug, evaluate, and monitor your LLM applications, RAG systems, and agentic workflows with comprehensive tracing, automated evaluations, and production-ready dashboards.

items.name: oumi
items.description: Easily fine-tune (SFT/RL), evaluate, and deploy Qwen, Gemma, or any open agentic LLM/VLM!

items.name: AI-Infra-Guard
items.description: A full-stack AI Red Teaming platform securing AI ecosystems via Agent Scan, Skills Scan, MCP scan, AI Infra scan and LLM jailbreak evaluation.

items.name: chinese-llm-benchmark
items.description: 非线智能 NoneLinear - ReLE评测：中文AI大模型能力评测（持续更新）：目前已囊括374个大模型，覆盖chatgpt、gpt-5.4、谷歌gemini-3.1-pro、Claude-4.6、文心ERNIE-X1.1、ERNIE-5.0、qwen3.6-max、qwen3.6-plus、百川、讯飞星火、商汤senseChat等商用模型， 以及step3.5-flash、kimi-k2.6、ernie4.5、MiniMax-M2.7、deepseek-v4、Qwen3.6、llama4、智谱GLM-5.1、MiMo-V2、LongCat、gemma4、mistral等开源大模型。不仅提供排行榜，也提供规模超200万的大模型缺陷库！方便广大社区研究分析、改进大模型。

items.name: ouroboros
items.description: Agent OS: the agent gets smarter on its own. We just hold the line: Interview-gated, staged evaluation, budgeted evolution loop. MCP server, 14 runtimes: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Copilot, Kiro and more.

items.name: helicone
items.description: 🧊 Open source LLM observability platform. One line of code to monitor, evaluate, and experiment. YC W23 🍓
